parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Source activities, assays, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Join activities to assays on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
